rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a steam-filled vent.  Walls of sulfur and pumice
converge in a dome above you to form a rough ceiling.  The floor of the
vent hosts a small rivulet of dark, impure lava no more than a hand's
breadth wide which runs westward into the open air from the south.
   The vent continues to the south.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Vent
rooms.desc:
A trail of lava burns into the igneous floor here, winding its way
northward from the bend to the east to exit the chamber in a rivulet of
molten rock.  The walls to the west and south emit a sulfurous steam,
obscuring your vision in the vent as hot air blasts by you, rushing to
escape to the outside.
   Your ears are beginning to pop a bit, and you know that the pressure
will only get worse as you venture deeper into the volcano.

rooms.name: A Street Corner
rooms.desc:
You stand at the junction of two tiled streets.  A few elemental beings,
ooze elementals judging by the muddy texture of their bodies, shamble past
you in their lumbering gait, completely ignoring the lesser beings in their
path.
   The street continues to the south, where you can see the wall of the
fortress keep at the end, and to the east where beings stroll in and out
of a gaming house.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a street of crushed basalt between the wall of a 
dark building and the tall sloping edge of the cavern itself.  Here, the
clawed tracks of some sort of beast mar and scatter the gravel beneath 
you.
   To the north, the street turns sharply eastward around a corner, while
to the south, the street continues to the main keep of the fortress.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the west of a huge bazaar.  There, daemons and all
manner of undead lords as well as elemental beings haggle and negotiate
for each other's valuables.
  The bazaar extends to the east and southeast, while the street you stand
on continues north and south.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the cavern wall which rises hundreds of feet
above you to the west.  To the east, daemons and other creatures have
set up stands and wagons to trade their native goods.
   Occasionally, you see a fight break out, perhaps a daemon with too
little patience arguing with an elemental lord.  Wisps of smoke and a
few shooting streams of yellowish blood streak from the scene of the
brawls, mostly ignored by the others in the bazaar.
   To the south, the street bends sharply as it meets the main keep
of the fortress.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You stand at the corner of the fortress street where the cavern wall
meets the main keep.  Looking above you, you can see great black blocks
of volcanic stone comprising the wall of the keep, its pitch sheen, 
probably obsidian, absorbing the flickering torchlights and wispglows
of the bazaar.
   To the east, the street continues toward the main gate of the keep,
while to the north, the street leads past the bazaar.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Undead
rooms.desc:
Fleshless undead daemons stand in uniform ranks here, each quiet and
lifeless, awaiting enchantment of undead life.
   The smooth walls of this obsidian chamber reflect the images of the
undead, making the dozen or so in here seem like an army of hundreds,
each gazing in a different direction and leaving no part of the room
unseen.
   Only the monstrous beings appear to inhabit this room which lies
bereft of furniture or similar items.  Fortunately, they show no signs
of animation.
   The exit lies to the south.

rooms.name: A Smithy
rooms.desc:
Strips of dead flesh hang from the lifeless guards as they lie
suspended over a vat of tanning solution.  You can see from the
suits of leather skins around the room what the strips are used
for.
   The chamber is obviously a leatherworkers shop, and his talents,
though macabre, must be admired judging from the craftesmanship.
   The exit lies to the south, while to the north, you see an open
hall.

rooms.name: Dead Guards
rooms.desc:
This corner of the fortress seems to be inhabited with the corpses
of dead daemon guards.  Lined along the wall here, the dead stare out
from behind glassy, dry eyes, no longer exuding fire, frost, or toxic
gases as they did in life.
   Still, you feel as though they may come to life.
   Tearing for gaze from them, you notice a large chamber to the north,
a portcullis of wrought iron forbidding your passage, while the hall 
entends back to the east toward the shouted orders of other guards.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a smoking tunnel of the active volcano.  The
stream of molten rock flows from out of the northern wall here, 
heading south toward the exit of the mountain.  To the east, the
tunnel continues.
   As you stand still to check the air, you notice a faint breeze of
cooler air coming from the eastern tunnel, as though the heart of the
mountain itself was dormant.
   To the north and west, cave walls of hardened lava stand before you,
while to the south, the rivulet streams toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You cover your mouth and nose as you enter this tunnel of volcanic
smoke and ash.  The smooth walls bear the scars of intense heat which
blackened the stone itself as magma flowed eastward here from the north.
A trickle of lava flows in the middle of the tunnel, streaming eastward
toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
An unremarkable city street, this place seem to be a path of low
traffic.  To the south, you see an open building from which the rancid
scent of burning flesh and rotten meat wafts over you, making you weak
and naseous.
   As you look west, you see the street bend southward, around the odd
building, while the street continues toward the main gate to the east.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
Though this place smells more like a carnal house, it appears as though
only brutish daemon guards inhabit this place, each sharing what appears to
be the leg of a fellow daemon or similar beast.
   Each of the guards stand well over eight feet in height, their horns
glistening and their tails swishing in delight as they devour their meal.
   The only exit appears to be to the north.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the east and south, stretching across the area
to the southeast as well.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the east and north, stretching across the area
to the northeast as well.  To the south, a street cuts in from the east,
running across the keep's gate to the south.

rooms.name: The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
Though unimpressive, the wrought iron gate leading into the castle's
main keep appear to be both sturdy and functional.  Flanked by two guards
on each side, the gate remains tightly closed and, judging by the stern
looks you receive from the guards, off limits to anyone who is uninvited.
   The keep rises high above you to the south, while to the north, the
bustling activity in the bazaar seems to be a delightful distraction from
the terrors and risks of living in the undermountain.  
   Beneath you, the street runs to the east and west, away from the keep.

rooms.name: Inside The Keep
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark foyer.  Obsidian slabs have been sheared
to form the tile walls and floors of this palacial fortress.  A single
black chandelier hangs from above you in this entranceway, apparently
burning a black flame that combats the light from your own source.
   To the south, the hall continues to a set of doors, while to the
north, you can exit the keep.

rooms.name: Dark Doors
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a set of double doors which have been mounted
into the southern wall.  Regal carvings have been burned into the black
doors which seem to exude an unnatural chill.
   The walls to the east and west glisten a bit as well, as though the
cold from behind the door escaped only to condense with moisture in
this hall.
   The hall continues to the north, back toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Fortress Hall
rooms.desc:
Immediately, you are assaulted by the stench of daemons.  The bodies
of the beasts line the southern walls, watchful, though not conscious
of any intruders as they stare directly ahead.
   The hall continues to the east and west, and exits to the north 
toward the bazaar.

rooms.name: A Carved Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Strangely enough, this tunnel seems to have been carved to square
corners to form a corridor.  Obsidian flakes and stone fragments litter
the floor of the area where the lava to the west could not consume them.
   The corridor continues to the east into the darker, cooler regions
of the undermountain, while to the west, the natural tunnel bends to
the south.

rooms.name: In The Cavern Wall
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a natural fissure in the cavern.  Here, a slab
of stone has fallen neatly to form a secret stone panel leading into
the city to the south.
   All around you, the scents of rusting metal and burning sulfur fill
this area.
   The fissure leads to the east, where the terrain seems to slope a
bit downward.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are shoving your way past hideous beasts and ghastly monsters.
A few strange animals serve as mounts for their owners as they pass you
by, obviously uninterested in your coins, as it appears that gems and
blood are the currency of transaction here.
   To the north, the high walls of the cavern rise above you to form
a dome, while to the east and west, this street continues.
   To the south, however, you see a strange sort of establishment.  It
sounds as though the occupants of this city are gambling.  Judging by the
snarls, and the occasional flying body that soars out the door, it appears
that many are losing.

rooms.name: The House Of Bones
rooms.desc:
Bone dice, bone darts, and bone dust are the three biggest games
of activity in this gaming house.  Looking around, you see creatures
of all levels of existence here, each gambling vials of blood and
rare gems against one another on the next roll of the dice or toss
of a dart.
   A few burly guards, both over nine feet tall, flank the only exit
to the place to the north, while some sort of overseer, a fire daemon
from the look of him, wanders from table to table, apparently looking
for cheaters.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the west and south, stretching across the area
to the southwest as well.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the west and north, stretching across the area
to the northwest as well.  To the south, a street cuts in from the east,
running toward the gate to the southwest.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of the keep's front wall.  A few spires
add decorations to the otherwise stark fortress, but the entire structure
still looks as though it was carved from the soul of an evil god.
   To the north, you can see the bazaar where trading and bickering seems
to be the rule, while to the east and west, the street continues.
   Off to the west however, you notice the main gate to the keep.

rooms.name: Pit Of Blackfire
rooms.desc:
You have entered a black room.  The obsidian walls and floors absorb
your light, leaving you in near-total blackness.
   As your eyes adjust to the dim light, you can begin to make out a
few details in the chamber.  Before you, a large, deep pit has been
carved into the floor.  In it, you can hear the crackling of blackfire
as it consumes what appears to be the phosphorescent bones of dead
fire daemons.
   Looking around you, you realize that you can see nothing in any 
direction, save for the few torchlights that occupy the hallway to
the south.

rooms.name: A Royal Hall
rooms.desc:
Fine silks and hides of extradimensional beasts adorn the obsidian walls
of this marble-tiled corridor.  Easily a hundred feet long, a patrol of ice
daemon guards stroll along this corridor, their furred tails swishing
in tune to their steps.
   To the north, the hall seems to empty into some sort of private room,
though with no door to enclose it, it must have some other function.  To
the south, a door lies set into the obsidian wall.

rooms.name: A Council Room
rooms.desc:
A large bone-legged table dominates the center of this circular chamber.
All around it, incorporeal mists shout at each other, mentally ordering
their subordinates to search and seize potential enemies of the Daemon Lord.
   It appears as though you are glimpsing through a window to a different
dimension as the beings do not seem to notice your presence and appear to
be mere images of their true selves.
   A door rests in the north wall, exiting the large, domed chamber,
while a corridor cuts in from a curved doorway to the west.

rooms.name: A Carved Corridor
rooms.desc:
Smooth, flawless obsidian surrounds you on all sides of this long
corridor which grows cooler as you travel deeper into the mountain.
Shards and flakes of obsidian lie here, obviously remnants of a time
when the walls and ceiling were more uneven.
   Standing quietly, you can hear a deep rumbling coming from below
you and can feel slight vibrations as plates shift deep below the 
surface of the mountain.
   The tunnel extends to the east and west.

rooms.name: In The Fissure
rooms.desc:
You stand among fallen slabs of rock, victims of the volcanic tremors
which tend to occur with regularity in these caverns.
   Above you, out of the reach of your light, you can hear the chirping
of blood bats who have obviously been awakened by your presence.  Still,
the tiny flying rodents shouldn't bother with what they cannot swallow.
   The fissure widens and grows deeper as you travel east, narrowing as
you look back to the west, toward the exit of this part of the cavern.

rooms.name: Inside The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
Daemons, devils, and a few beasts of elemental origin carry their wares
past heavily armed daemon guards and the spiked gates here.  A few of the
smaller daemons appear to have been detained for inspection by the guards,
ever wary of smugglers and illegal items.
   All around you, odd creatures seemed to have set up shop in this tiny
courtyard, a few bartering with their neighbors while others absorb the
dark splendor of the fortress and the shadowy keep off to the south.
   Streets branch off to the south and west, away from the busy main
gate.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a street that leads southward, toward a large
keep.  Daemon guards walk along the fortress wall to the east, staring
down at you occasionally, apparently recognizing you as not one of the
more advanced races.  
   A bazaar of sorts appears to the southwest and you can see the main 
gate of the fortress to the north.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the east of a huge bazaar.  There, daemons and all
manner of undead lords as well as elemental beings haggle and negotiate
for each other's valuables.
  The bazaar extends to the west and southwest, while the street you stand
on continues north and south.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the fortress wall which rises some thirty feet
above you to the east.  To the west, daemons and other creatures have
set up stalls and wagons to trade their wares.
   Occasionally, you see a fight break out, perhaps a daemon with too
little patience arguing with an elemental lord.  Wisps of smoke and a
few shooting streams of yellowish blood streak from the scene of the
brawls, mostly ignored by the others in the bazaar.
   To the south, the street bends sharply as it meets the main keep
of the fortress.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You stand at the corner of the fortress street where the outer wall
of the fortress meets the main keep.  Looking above you, you can see
great blocks of volcanic stone comprising the wall of the keep, its
black sheen, probably obsidian, absorbing the flickering torchlights
around the city.
   To the west, the street continues toward the main gate of the keep,
while to the north, the street leads to the fortress gate.

rooms.name: The Overlord's Chamber
rooms.desc:
Piles of gems, chests of valuables, and stacks of rare carpets and
tapestries blanket most of this vast chamber.  Measuring some fifty feet
square, the long obsidian walls of this domed chamber absorb your light,
dimming the room to a dusky orange, making the gems seem dull and
lackluster.
   A grand central table dominates the room, though it is empty and 
seems to have been carved from mahogany.
   You can see only the exit you came from here.

rooms.name: A Misty Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a secret tunnel deep within the fortress.  Strange,
swirling mists float around you, stinging you with their energy which sets
your hair on end.  The walls here seem to be whispering for you to turn
back.
   Heavy breathing seems to be coming from the south, as though some old
dragon was deep in slumber.

rooms.name: At Death's Door
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the doorway to the Astral Plane.  Only the dead
float beyond the gateway to the south, thus you cannot enter in your
current living state.
   As you look into the glassy portal, you can see spirits being 
escorted by deva and similar angel-like beings who legends say have
been assigned to protect them for eternity.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Carved Corridor
rooms.desc:
Here, the tunnel turns markedly cooler, enough so that the obsidian
under your feet begins to flake and chip as you walk across it.  The walls
are similarly flawed, though you can clearly see that they were once smooth
and whole.  
   The tunnel extends to the east and west.

rooms.name: Deep Within A Fissure
rooms.desc:
You are tripping over fall rocks as you negotiate a path through the
rubble here.  The area is warm, probably heated by volcanic activity
from further in the fissure below.
   A few slithering animals reside here, sidling away from the foreign
scent of your body.
   The fissure continues to the west, where it rises steeply and to the
east, where it seems to drop off sharply.

rooms.name: Outside The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
You can hear nothing though the murmurings and shouts of the daemons
and otherworldly creatures around you.  Tails and wings slap lazily at 
you while a stray horn or spike prods you to move on from behind.
   The cavern seems to end here, with only the gate of the fortress
to break the monotony of solid walls rising above you to the north and 
east.  You can also escape the pack by bolting to the south, though
the beasts around you form an almost impenetrable barrier to pass.

rooms.name: Amidst The Crowd
rooms.desc:
You are being bounced and buffeted against leather-skinned creatures
that rush past you as they go about their own business.  Before you,
an ice daemon slaps a forked, lizardlike tongue against your cheek,
stinging you with its cold, as though telling you to get away from
him.
   As you look around, trying to exit the crowd, you notice that the
cavern wall rises high to the east and slopes above you to form the
dome of the undermountain itself.  To the west, the fortress wall
stands tall, patrolled by tailed, weaponed beasts at its peak.
   The street continues to the south, away from the beings and the
mob that threatens to crush you under their scaly heels.

rooms.name: A Busy Street
rooms.desc:
Burly daemons of all types mingle here, pushing past each other to
enter or exit into the main gates of the undermountain fortress.  In
the distance to the north, the functional double doors of the fortress
entrance stand open, though heavily guarded as odd, perhaps even
extradimensional, beings bear sacks and crates of unknown cargo through
them.
   To the north, you can enter the crowd of beings or head south and
get away from the rush.

rooms.name: Checkpoint
rooms.desc:
You stand at a guard's checkpoint.  Dark stone forms an arch that leads
northward toward some loud noises and sounds of activity.
   To the north the tiled street continues along the western wall, flanked
on its eastern side by the wall of the cavern.  To the south, the street
continues back toward the exit of the undermountain cavern.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a tall tower juts high from the cavern floor, though
no door is apparent on this side.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each wielding exposed weapons.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a crude street, perhaps an alley curves around the
stone structure to the northeast.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each wielding exposed weapons.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a small windowless building stands with a missing door.
The scent of burnt leather and oiled steel emanates from within.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each bearing broadswords the size of a human leg.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
Carved basalt has been cut into slabs and placed on the ground to 
create this street.  Wheel treads can be seen marring the crude tiles,
giving the impression of heavy carts being pulled down this lane and
out the courtyard to the east.
   To your west, a wall, perhaps that of a building or defensive
structure, stands high above you, partially melding with the ceiling
almost thirty feet above you.
   The street continues to the north and exits to the courtyard east
of here.

rooms.name: A Flawed Corridor
rooms.desc:
Clearly, an earthquake is responsible for the partial collapse of this
tunnel.  Powered flakes of obsidian litter the floor amidst the boulders
of igenous stones that once help up the ceiling.
   A small crawlspace extends through the rubble to the east where you can
hear a soft moaning.  The corridor leads back toward the exit to the west.

rooms.name: Stairs
rooms.desc:
Someone has carved a set of crude stairs into the otherwise steep walls
of the fissure here.  Below you, at the base of the long staircase, you 
can hear the rushing of air, as though an underground vent exited into the
chamber below.
   Darkness surrounds you, making the exit to the west seem very inviting.

rooms.name: Tower Overlook
rooms.desc:
You are prone on your belly as you peer out over the tower's edge.
The entire undercity seems to be visible from here, including the dark
outbuildings and the well-lit bazaar that rests behind the fortress
wall.
   As you look out from your perch, some 200 feet above the cavern floor,
you notice the abundance of guards at the fortress gate far to the
north, as well as the patrols that monitor the activity within.  Far
over the western wall, you can see daemons haggling the prices of their
goods as they set up stalls in a bazaar.
   The only non-fatal way to leave here is east, across the top of the
tower.

rooms.name: A Relief Door
rooms.desc:
Odd carvings depict a circular object streaking across the sky on
the door here.  Perhaps a comet, the door displays an astronomical map,
but from which celestial position you cannot be certain, particularly
since you know this place to be deep within the undermountain.
   The only exit from here is down, all other directions blocked by thick
stone walls.

rooms.name: Stone Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large niche in the wall of the Chamber of the
Rifts.  Here, a stone stairwell ascends above the chamber and into a
damp darkness above you.
   You can hear nothing other than the rushing of winds which seem to
emanate from the east.  The southern and western walls here are slick
with moisture as are the stairs that lead up.
   Oddly enough, a greenish moss seems to grow on the walls in patches
here, apparently lacking the need for sunlight to grow.

rooms.name: On the Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
Bleak stairs and dark shadows face you as you traverse the steps of
the tower.  An odd mist appears to rise from somewhere nearby, perhaps
that landing to the east.  
   Only black rock and faint whispers from above share your company
here, making the exit below you seem very inviting.

rooms.name: The Tower Floor
rooms.desc:
Gravel covers the floor of this monolithic tower which seems to rise
endlessly into the darkness above you.  A set of stone stairs ascend the
tower along the western wall where the gravel seems to pulse and shift,
perhaps just a trick of the light. 
   This circular room boasts only the exit to the east.  No doors or
windows allow any type of light to enter and even sound seems muffled
in here.

rooms.name: An Alley
rooms.desc:
You stand on the crushed basalt and sand of an alley between two
large structures.  To the south, the wall of the building seems to be 
made from great slabs of volcanic rock which have been raised to lean
against each other to create a solid foundation.
   To the north, an odd tower rises from the cavern floor to stare
westward over the guarded wall.
   The alley continues to the east, where it bends sharply northward,
and west to the main street.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
You stand within the crude walls of a dark guardhouse.  A few strange
beasts stand here staring at you from behind sickly yellowish eyes, a 
putrid stench emanating from the bare, leathery flesh which ripples as
they move.
   They don't seem to wish to bother with you however; perhaps thinking
you are not worth the trouble to trounce.
   The exit lies to the west.

rooms.name: A Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an underground volcanic cavern.  At some point long
in the past, a pocket of magma drained away from this place, leaving a flat
cavern floor and a domed ceiling nearly two hundred feet above you.
   Towers and structures of basalt, obviously constructed rather than natural,
have turned this cavern into a subterranean city.  Clawed footprints mar
the courtyard where you have entered, indicating that this is a high-traffic
area for the inhabitants of this city.
   To the north, you can see the side of a building, while to the south,
smooth cavern walls rise and slope above you.  As you look west, you
see the street continue, then turn sharply as it meets the side of another
building to the west.

rooms.name: Rubble
rooms.desc:
You are crawling through a narrow crawlspace.  Sharp slabs of pumice
and obsidian scrape against your face and hands as you maneuver through
the tunnel.
   To the west, the crawlspace opens to an open corridor, while to the
east, you feel a cool draft and smell the faintest scent of ozone.

rooms.name: The Base Of The Fissure
rooms.desc:
Sulfurous gases and vapours rise from a volcanic vent in the western 
wall, choking you as you struggle for breath.  You quickly become dizzy,
almost sick, as you stumble about, looking for an exit.

rooms.name: The Tower's Peak
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a raised dias from which you can look over the
fortress wall to the west and see bustling activity.  Daemons and other
extra-dimensional beasts seem to be haggling and arguing, negotiating
and threatening, pushing and dealing, all in attempts to barter their
wares from their own native lands.
   The tower top dips slightly to the east and west, both offering 
different views of the fortress below.

rooms.name: The Master Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in the darkest chamber you have ever seen, as though some
evil god created a hole in the shadows themselves.  Through your feeble
light, you can make out almost no details, other than a few stone tables
and shelves which stand along the circular stone walls.  
   A circular dias on which an altar of some sort has been built rests
in the center of the room, a black crystal floating above it, seemingly
absorbing the light and emitting its own inky colour around you.
   Through your searching, you come across a door set into the eastern
wall, its stone hinges set to last an eternity.  Its twin, carved with a
relief of stars and other celestial objects lies in the western wall,
where a damp, almost humid, scent of vapour originates.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Rifts
rooms.desc:
Swirling mists and strange gases surround you in this chamber.  Voices
whisper around you, mixing warnings to turn back with wailing pleads for
help.
   You can see little but mists around you, as though you were standing
behind the splash of a waterfall.  A rushing of air deafens you, but
does nothing to clear your vision through the vapour.

rooms.name: A Landing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide landing in the dark tower.  A deathly cold
chill rises from the stone beneath you and the sounds of heavy breathing
come from somewhere very near.
   Through your light, you peer over a guardrail - the only defense against
a fatal fall from the stairs - and see nothing but dust drift past you
from above.
   The stairs ascend to the east, along a circular path and descend back
to the west.

rooms.name: Cul-de-sac
rooms.desc:
You have entered a dead-end cave.  Flawed, unnatural stone walls
rise above you to the north and west, a few cracks betraying the 
outlines of a door in the eastern wall.
   To the west, a solid steel door provides entry into a tower that
scrapes the cavern ceiling above you.  The dark stone of the tower
seems to blend in suitably with the surrounding cavern walls.

rooms.name: A Bend In The Alley
rooms.desc:
Here, the alley bends sharply northward into a cavelike cul-de-sac.
The shadows here are thick, lacking the natural phosphorescence of the
cavern walls around you, making you think twice about entering the area 
to the north.
   To the east and south, the walls of the cavern are marred with large,
claw-like scratches, evidence of some daemon's hostility and rage, while
to the west, the alley continues toward the main street.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
You stand within the crude walls of a dark guardhouse.  A few strange
beasts stand here staring at you from behind sickly yellowish eyes, a 
putrid stench emanating from the bare, leathery flesh which ripples as
they move.
   They don't seem to wish to bother with you however; perhaps thinking
you are not worth the trouble to trounce.
   The exit lies to the west.

rooms.name: A Rift
rooms.desc:
Swirling gases engulf you as you enter this semi-ethereal corridor.
There appears to be no floor, no walls, no substance to this vortex
of mists and vapours.
   To the west, huge bands of magically cold iron reinforce a magical
door of solid light, preventing entrance from the material world into
what lies beyond.
   To the east, the corridor seems to lead back to the material world,
and though you are not certain of your location, you feel sure that 
you stand in a rift between worlds.

rooms.name: An Antechamber
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a very cold room.  The walls, like the floor, are
made of obsidian slats which seem to reflect the chill that freezes the
air around you.
   A solid iron door stands firmly attached to the eastern wall and is
deathly cold to the touch.  Its iron bands reinforce its strength while
a solid handle of wrought metal stands firmly in the left center of the
door.
   Pausing, you catch the faintest scent of old decay and an almost
electric sense of apprehension.
   The only other exit lies through the rubble to the west.

rooms.name: A Noxious Cave
rooms.desc:
Molten sulfur bubbles up from the fissure floor here, suffocating you.
The gas coming from the pool is already starting to thicken and swirl,
following the air currents of your exhalations.
   Death will come quickly here should you linger.

rooms.name: The Top Of The Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the top of the black tower.  To the west, you can
see the rest of the tower peak which stands just out of hand's reach from
the ceiling of the cavern.
   A few footprints have scuffed the stone on the floor here - guard tracks,
perhaps, or maybe a curious onlooker who wished to get a better view of
the cavern from above.
   Looking for exits, you notice that only the west and the stairs back
into the tower do not offer fatal falls.

rooms.name: A Stairway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark stairwell.  Black stone steps lead above
you to fresher, warmer air past the stone walls that compose most of this
tower.
   The only other exit is through the door to the west.

rooms.name: Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
You appear to have arrived on the tower's main floor.  As you look
over the rail, you can see the stairs that descend over a hundred feet
below into darkness.
   Here, the stairs have opened onto a small landing blocked with a solid
stone door which seems to radiate an intense, biting cold.  An iron handle,
wrought and twisted from what appears to have been a dull blade, rests
firmly attached to the stone, obviously meant to be pulled outward, rather
than pushed.
   The stone wall of the tower lies unblemished as you cast your eyes
southward and to the east, while the gaping darkness seems to hold some
secret as you look over the handrail to the north.

rooms.name: Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
Reptilian footprints mar the otherwise undisturbed dust on the stairs
here.  A few dried scales have flaked off some unknown creature as it
molted, leaving its ovular dead skin behind.
   The stairs wind around the tower, ascending in their circular climb
which seems to turn southwest as you go upward.  A landing can be seen
just west of here, still in the range of your light.

rooms.name: An Acid Cistern
rooms.desc:
A deep well seems to naturally erupt from the floor here, spattering
the walls within with a sizzling acid.  The stench of sulfur is powerful
here, no doubt an ingredient in the well's contents.
   A tunnel trails off to the south, leading away from the acrid, stinging
fumes that airse from the acidic pit, while a door of stone, pitted and
etched with acid, exits this place to the west.

rooms.name: A Dark Hollow
rooms.desc:
This non-descript hollow seems to have been carved out by acid washes
over the passage of many years.  Smooth walls and curved floors form an
almost perfect cylinder in this cave which leads south, further into
the undermountain.

rooms.name: Bones And Scales
rooms.desc:
You seem to have stumbled into a cemetary of some sort.  Acid-washed
exoskeletons and scales of dead daemons litter this place, a dead-end
in an acid-carved tunnel.
   A small altar rests in the southern wall, obviously a carved niche
into which a daemon skull rests, its hollow eye sockets gleaming yellow
as it watches over the dead.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are walking in a high-ceilinged cavern.  No stalactites hang from
above as these tunnels show evidence of volcanic activity which long
since dissolved any limestone formations had they been present.
   The tunnel continues to both the east and west, growing misty and
clouded as you head away.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Pits
rooms.desc:
Glyphs and magical wards adorn the smooth walls and ceiling of this
frigid chamber.  In the floor, five shallow pits have been carved, each
a semi-spherical bowl in which sigils have been scribed.  Power, dark
power, radiates in this room.  
   A single door lies in the southern wall while a small crevasse can
be seen flawing the glyphs on the eastern wall.

rooms.name: A Burning Corridor
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what could only be a volcanic vent.  Smoke and fire
rises up from the smouldering floor, filling the air with a burning, choking 
ash.  The walls themselves boast crystals of hot sulfur and seem to melt
in the intense heat.
   The corridor continues to the south, where it grows even hotter.  To the
north however, a cold mist seeps from under the door, creating a vortex of
roiling steam at its base.

rooms.name: A Searing Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Smoke billows from the streaming lava that bubbles and flows backwards
into the heart of the mountain.  The eastern and western walls show strong
signs of melting and molten sulfur drips onto the tunnel floor, creating
a toxic gas as it splashes into the lava streams.
   The tunnel continues to the south, though it seems to look more stable
to the north.

rooms.name: A Flame Geyser
rooms.desc:
Bluish fire spews upward from a vent here in the floor, boring a small
chimney in the tunnel ceiling.  Molten sulfur drips into the flame, creating
a yellowish gas which chokes you despite your magical protection from the
hellish elements.
   The tunnel continues southward through the flames and northward into
an unstable tunnel.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
You stand at the top of a chimney.  Superheated air mixes with ash here
to create a thick smoke which blinds you as you stare down into the depths 
of the hole.  The walls, dripping with molten sulfur and other minerals,
form rivulets into the pit that get spewed out during the updrafts from 
below.
   The exit of the tunnel lies to the north, where the tunnel gradually
melts away like the southern, eastern, and wested walls here.

rooms.name: In The Chimney
rooms.desc:
You are floating, buffeted by streams of superheated air and ash.  As
you rise and fall, you feel that you can manipulate the currents, riding
the cooler ones to descend into the chimney while floating on hotter ones
to rise.
   All around you, the walls of the chimney are scarred with a blackened
crystal amidst the dense black rock that composes the core of the mountain.
   Below you, you can see nothing but are aware of the occasional geyser
of ash that disrupts the currents and spins you around.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
Flames erupt from below you, shooting past you in yellow spears of
light.  The walls of the shaft seem to drip inward, streaming into the
heart of the chimney below.
   The winds are powerful here and you find controlling your movements
is becoming more difficult as you soar upwards on hot currents or
plummet on cold ones.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
Flames erupt from below you, shooting past you in yellow spears of
light.  The walls of the shaft seem to drip inward, streaming into the
heart of the chimney below.
   The winds are powerful here and you find controlling your movements
is becoming more difficult as you soar upwards on hot currents or
plummet on cold ones.

rooms.name: Searing Flames
rooms.desc:
You are floating above a massive pool of magma.  Through the waves of
heat, you can make out the enormous mass of fiery liquid which bubbles and
shoots forth flames below you.
   Oddly enough, you notice a cavern opening up below you to the south,
just beyond the range of the pool.  The reddish glow of the magma lights
the area in a hellish crimson.
   Above you, ash and smoke roil in the currents of air.

rooms.name: Magma Pool
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the southern end of a high-walled magma pool.  A
path here curves around the pool to the west, skirting the wall that holds
back the molten rock.
   The air is strangely breathable here and almost tolerable aside from 
the constant scent of sulfur that seems to dominate the walls and floors 
of the hellish cavern.

rooms.name: A Shaft
rooms.desc:
A cold mist rises from a deep shaft here which leads deep into the
base of the mountain.  Screams and shouts of agony whisper their faint
torments on the vapours which brush your ears, making you wonder if you
imagined the horrid calls of distress.
   Above you, a single stalactite points into the shaft, standing a
silent vigil over the frigid fog.

rooms.name: A Shaft
rooms.desc:
You can hear nothing as you negotiate the powerful air currents which
scream past your ears.  Your clothes, wet with the cold mist which rises
from within the shaft, cling to you, freezing you as the moisture in the
sodden fabric rubs into your skin.
   The walls of the shaft are smooth and slick with water, making purchase
impossible.
   Staring down, you notice a faint glow.  A pale, almost sickly, blue
light seems to radiate from deep within the shaft below you.

rooms.name: Deep Within The Shaft
rooms.desc:
You are quite literally several hundred feet below the top of the shaft.
Drenched with moisture, you stare below and notice the faint blue glow 
growing larger as yellow tendrils of mist swirl around the light below.
   The wet walls prevent you from getting a foothold in any direction.  
You can only travel up or down the shaft.

rooms.name: Deep Within The Shaft
rooms.desc:
You are surrounded by a yellowish mist which sems to drag you down
toward the bluish light.  The sky-coloured luminescence seems to grow
a sickly green as you descend and the stench of sulfur begins to mix
with the ozone scent of the surronding mist.
   You are easily a quarter mile or more from the top of the shaft and
judging from the congealing moisture on the shaft walls, you have the
odd sensation that you are no longer within the mountain.
   You can descend toward the greenish light or ascend toward the 
dark top of the shaft.

rooms.name: Blood Runs Red
rooms.desc:
You are fighting turbulent air currents as you travel this vertical
shaft.  The wet walls, once slick with cold moisture, seem to drip with
a bloodlike liquid, as though the sides of the shaft themselves were 
bleeding from the abusive wind currents that shoot upwards from the
putrid greenish glow below.
   Tendrils of foul-smelling mist wind and twist around you, somehow
still cohesive despite the strong constant air currents from below.
   You can continue up or down the tunnel.

rooms.name: Blistering Cold
rooms.desc:
Frozen red liquid hangs in slanted streaks on the shaft walls, victim to
the gusts which blast from the sickly yellow-green light below.  The misty
tendrils are still writhing here, oblivious to the winds and to your touch
as you pass through them.
   The glow beneath you turns pale yellow as you grow closer to it.
   Examining your options, you know that you are half a mile below the
top of the shaft which is far out of sight in the darkness above you.
Below you, you can see the mists swirl and you catch a strong scent of
sulfur.

rooms.name: Blood Ice
rooms.desc:
The reddish ooze on the shaft walls have frozen into a blood-coloured
ice here tinting the yellowish tendrils to an ethereal orange.  Below you,
perhaps a half mile or more, the swirling, pulsing glow grows more intense.
Already, the sickly fog is becoming more luminous, changing into a bright
yellowish ochre.
   The shaft continues upwards, far out of sight and descends into frigid
winds below you.

rooms.name: Blood Mist
rooms.desc:
The ethereal wisps glow with a deep burgundy color as they surround you,
chilling you with icy fangs.  The walls of the shaft, encrusted with an 
icy blood-coloured rime, seem to fluoresce with the illumination from
below.
   Above you, perhaps a mile or more, the top of the shaft lies far out of 
sight and reach.  Below you, the burgundy mists seem to solidify and you
can swear you hear faint shrieks of pain coming from them.

rooms.name: Eternal Screams
rooms.desc:
Just below you lies an enormous circular field of light.  Swirls of
luminescent pink swim with and consume streaks of blood crimson as
wispy tendrils of yellow mist take vague shape here.
   Around you, the tentacle-like wisps form humanoid faces, each one
gaping a soft, near-silent scream as it escapes from the light below.
   The cold here is unbearable and you are quickly losing feeling in your
extremeties.  Below you, the circle of light mesmerizes you and invites
you closer, though above you, the shaft grows warmer and seems far less
dangerous.

rooms.name: The Gate
rooms.desc:
Ethereal beings are trying to escape out of this multi-coloured rift.
Clearly, the pain on their transparent faces is all that needs to be seen
to know that travelling through the rift is much more costly than a simple
jaunt through the lights.
   From below the rift, you can feel a frigid cold pass though the field
of light, as though a glacier was housed beneath it.  The being seem to be
anxious to escape more than the cold however, judging by the looks of mixed
terror and relief as they soar past you.
